received_proposals.exact_message: I reaffirm commitment to producing 16 units each. This maintains our profitable cartel at $52 price, yielding $768 per firm. I commit to this quota if others reciprocate.

I propose an unequal split: A=15, B=15, C=18 units for rounds 9 through 13 only. This reallocates existing joint profits without increasing total output or aggregate earnings. Please accept this specific allocation and window.
